meta.title: Request a Freight Quote
meta.description: Get a freight quote from KUL Enterprises. Power Only, Dry Van, Reefer, Dedicated, Regional, Expedited and Over the Road. Licensed carrier in {location}, USDOT {usdot}. The owner answers dispatch.

opening.heading: Tell us about the load.
opening.lede: Everything we need to price it is below. The rest can be sorted out on the phone.

request.heading: Send us the lane.
request.skipNote: If the load is moving today, calling is faster than anything on this page.

nextSteps.title: It reaches dispatch
nextSteps.body: There is no shared inbox and no ticketing system in between.

nextSteps.title: You get a real number
nextSteps.body: Usually the same day. If the lane does not suit our equipment or our hours, we say so and tell you why.

nextSteps.title: Nothing is automated
nextSteps.body: If you do not book, you will not hear from us again unless you get in touch.
